verdict.rationale: The firm's About page documents GDHQ as a secure platform giving clients access to their company's key corporate records, plus contract generation and SMART Request intake. Catalyze is a client-exclusive portal with access to the Gunderson legal team, and a D&O Questionnaire Portal covers one specific workflow. This shows a firm-documented secure client portal for documents, but matter-level views and status tracking are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented matter/status tracking in the portal, security details (access controls, encryption), depth of document-sharing features, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: GDHQ is a secure platform that offers easy access to your company's key corporate records
Access premium tools, your Gunderson legal team, and invite-only events available exclusively to our clients.
The D&O Questionnaire Portal is a web-based, tech-forward tool designed to simplify and streamline the process of completing the Director and Officer (D&O) questionnaires
